sources.title: How to Fine-Tune the Donut Model - With Example Use Case
sources.snippet: Conclusion In this article, I have shown you how to easily fine-tune the Donut model using your own data, something which will hopefully result in improved accuracy for your fine-tuned Donut model. The applicabilities of the Donut model are many, and this is just one way to use it, which I hope is useful.
